name: 34th Annual Symposium of the Society for Nonlinear Dynamics and Econometrics (SNDE 2027)
organizer: Society for Nonlinear Dynamics and Econometrics (SNDE); hosted by Pomona College
conf_dates_note: The call PDF body text says "April 2--3, 2026" (typo); its header and the website give April 2-3, 2027.
deadline_note: Stated as "Deadline for abstract/paper submissions: October 30, 2026"
submission_requirements: Completed manuscripts or extended abstracts via Conference Maker; select one of five topic areas: Empirical Macro, Finance, Forecasting, Macro Theory, Time-Series. Student/young researcher prizes (indicate interest on the submission page). Registration fees and accommodation details to be posted on the Society website.
keynotes: Oscar Jorda (Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco); Allan Timmermann (UC San Diego)
journal: Authors of accepted papers encouraged to submit to Studies in Nonlinear Dynamics & Econometrics
